title: Recipient cannot attend the scheduled delivery window
next_action_text: Ask the recipient to choose from dispatcher-confirmed alternative slots.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the selected replacement slot; delivery itself remains pending.
boundaries: Do not promise arrival at a precise minute or say the lamp has been delivered.
notes: two dispatcher-confirmed slots in Context; the desk cannot pick for the customer

title: Apartment number missing from the delivery address
next_action_text: Ask the authenticated recipient for the missing apartment number through the approved channel.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the corrected address on the shipment.
boundaries: Authentication was independently recorded; do not infer it just from the customer’s assertion. No delivery claim.
notes: ask only for the apartment number; no entry codes; verification was recorded by the account team

title: Driver cannot access a gated residential building
context_author: Route driver Fen Orlo, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Contact the recipient for permitted access instructions without requesting reusable security credentials.
outcome: Driver confirms access was obtained and the parcel was handed over.
boundaries: Do not request or store permanent credentials. Handover is supported by the driver’s actual record.
notes: driver waiting at the gate until 10:00; call the verified callback route; no reusable gate code

title: Recipient requests a call shortly before arrival
next_action_text: Send the recipient's agreed callback request to dispatch.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the notification instruction is recorded; arrival remains pending.
boundaries: Recorded instruction is not proof of a call or of arrival.
notes: callback request to dispatch; no contact change; no guaranteed interval

title: Recipient asks for an authorised household member to receive the parcel
next_action_text: Ask the recipient to nominate a receiver under the operator's stated service conditions.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the approved receiver is recorded; handover remains pending.
boundaries: This policy is limited to the stated ordinary parcel; nomination is not delivery.
notes: nomination must be recorded before route release; ordinary parcel service only

title: Customer requests collection from a staffed pickup point
next_action_text: Ask the routing team to move an eligible shipment to the customer's chosen available pickup point.
outcome: The pickup point confirms the parcel is available and the customer receives collection instructions.
boundaries: Ready for collection is not collected. Do not invent a universal identification requirement.
notes: choice already recorded; redirect eligible before route release; notify only on physical receipt

title: Pickup deadline is too short for the recipient
next_action_text: Request an extension from the pickup-point operator within its stated policy.
outcome: The operator confirms the new collection deadline and the recipient is notified.
boundaries: An extension does not prove the customer collected the parcel.
notes: single two-day extension allowed by operator policy; must be requested before expiry

title: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate
next_action_text: Request available timed slots from the scheduling team.
outcome: Scheduling confirms the customer's selected slot and any agreed service charge; delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Scheduling reports the accepted charge; the desk does not set prices or assert payment.
notes: quote slots and upgrade charge first; no change until the customer accepts; the desk does not set prices

title: Bulky delivery requires the recipient to clear an access route
context_author: Furniture delivery team, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask the recipient to confirm the access checklist supplied by the delivery team.
outcome: The delivery team accepts the confirmed access details and keeps the booking active.
boundaries: Customer measurements support planning, not a guarantee of safe unloading on arrival.
notes: crew checklist (90 cm, no obstacles, no stairs); do not tell the customer to move heavy items

title: Recipient wants delivery held during a short absence
next_action_text: Request an eligible temporary hold from dispatch using the recipient's confirmed return date.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the hold and the planned release date; no delivery is claimed.
boundaries: No delivery date or physical receipt follows merely from the planned release.
notes: hold up to three calendar days; a release date is not a delivery date

title: Shipment tracking has not updated after depot arrival
next_action_text: Ask the destination depot for a physical scan and shipment location.
outcome: The depot supplies a fresh scan and verified location; delivery remains open.
boundaries: A physical depot scan is not proof of dispatch or delivery.
notes: the arrival scan alone does not answer; demand a physical location scan

title: Promised delivery day missed after vehicle breakdown
next_action_text: Ask dispatch for a replacement delivery slot.
outcome: Dispatch confirms a replacement booking and the customer acknowledges the revised plan.
boundaries: Customer acknowledgement closes rebooking only, not delivery.
notes: carrier-confirmed breakdown; rebook within customer availability; no charge is visible at escalation but any service change should ask about charges

title: Recipient disputes a recorded failed delivery attempt
gold_recipient: Dispatch review team, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt.
outcome: Dispatch confirms the review result and a replacement attempt; successful delivery is not assumed.
boundaries: A corrected stop error is not proof of fraud; the replacement attempt remains pending.
notes: disputed failed-attempt scan; ask for the review finding; do not infer fault either way

title: Driver arrives after the business receiving desk closes
requester: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
gold_recipient: Rellin Vos, Vellum Rack receiving coordinator
next_action_text: Contact the business receiving coordinator to obtain the next staffed window.
outcome: Dispatch confirms a new attempt within the agreed receiving hours.
boundaries: Shop opening hours and staffed receiving hours are different facts.
notes: staffed receiving window and entrance needed before dispatch can book

title: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot
next_action_text: Ask the carrier routing team to transfer it to the correct depot.
outcome: The correct depot confirms physical receipt by scan; final delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.
notes: confirmed misroute; transfer to the correct depot; proof is the destination receipt scan not a planned linehaul

title: Pickup locker is full
next_action_text: Ask the carrier to offer an available alternative collection location to the recipient.
outcome: The recipient accepts an option and the new location confirms readiness for collection.
boundaries: An accepted alternative alone is not readiness; this case has an actual counter scan. Collection remains open.
notes: locker full; the carrier offers a staffed counter and must obtain the customer's choice before routing; same shape as DEL-008

title: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link
next_action_text: Ask carrier support to provide the correct tracking reference through the verified customer channel.
outcome: The customer confirms access to the correct shipment tracking page.
boundaries: Tracking access is not delivery. No live URL or credentials are provided.
notes: malformed link; provide reference and navigation; never send payment requests or ask for credentials

title: Shipment is approaching its return-to-sender deadline
next_action_text: Contact the recipient to choose a permitted redelivery or collection option before the stated cutoff.
outcome: The carrier confirms the agreed option and cancels the scheduled return.
boundaries: Only carrier confirmation establishes cancellation of the return; collection remains pending.
notes: return-to-sender at 16:00 today; two options; call the authorised recipient now

title: Severe weather suspends the delivery route
context_author: Route safety control, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask dispatch for its approved disruption update and next scheduled review time.
outcome: The customer receives the verified suspension notice and review time; no unsupported arrival promise is made.
boundaries: A review time is not a route-restart time or guaranteed delivery time.
notes: weather suspension; relay approved wording and next review time; never invent an ETA

title: A multi-parcel order arrives with one parcel still outstanding
gold_recipient: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask the carrier to locate the missing parcel using its individual tracking ID.
outcome: The recipient confirms receipt of that remaining parcel; the order's parcel count reconciles.
boundaries: Closure is for the three-parcel count, not product quality or installation.
notes: multi-parcel order; trace the missing unit by its own ID; do not close on partial scans

title: Outer packaging is damaged and the merchant needs evidence
next_action_text: Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel.
outcome: The merchant confirms receipt of sufficient evidence for assessment; compensation remains undecided.
boundaries: Rendered scene simulations are not real photographs or proof of actual physical damage. Receipt of these fictional evidence views does not establish contents condition or compensation.
notes: merchant specifies two image views via the order-linked upload; do not ask to unpack if unsafe; compensation undecided

title: A delivered household item is confirmed broken
next_action_text: Request replacement authorisation from the merchant using the accepted damage evidence.
outcome: The merchant confirms a replacement order and its reference; replacement delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Merchant approval and reserved stock do not establish replacement dispatch or receipt.
notes: inspection already accepted; customer chose replacement; the merchant approves

title: A leaking parcel is reported at the depot
requester: Depot shift coordinator, Plover Arc Logistics
context_author: Depot shift coordinator, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Escalate to the carrier's safety lead for its handling instructions; do not ask customers or drivers to handle the leak.
outcome: The safety lead confirms the parcel is isolated and records the next handling step; contents and liability remain unassessed.
boundaries: Do not identify the liquid, declare it safe or give cleanup instructions. Emergency procedures remain with safety staff.
notes: leaking parcel; safety lead takes over; no driver or customer handling; no advice about the liquid

title: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
next_action_text: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details.
outcome: The carrier registers the investigation and provides a case reference and next update time.
boundaries: The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.
notes: delivered scan vs the verified recipient's no-receipt report; register an investigation; no loss or fraud finding

title: Carrier confirms a parcel is lost after investigation
next_action_text: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option.
outcome: The merchant confirms the replacement order; shipment and delivery are separate later stages.
boundaries: Confirmed loss does not mean the desk can approve replacement or claim its delivery.
notes: carrier loss confirmed; customer chose replacement; only the merchant can approve

title: Parcel was handed to the wrong address and the carrier located it
next_action_text: Ask the carrier to arrange recovery and correct redelivery without sharing third-party contact details.
outcome: The intended recipient confirms receipt and the carrier records the corrected handover.
boundaries: Do not reveal the wrong-address resident’s name, address or contact details. No contents-quality claim.
notes: carrier located the parcel; recovery by the carrier; never expose the other household

title: Customer receives another customer's parcel
next_action_text: Arrange carrier collection using the carrier's approved process; do not request opening or forwarding by the customer.
outcome: The carrier confirms collection of the misdelivered parcel; the customer's own order remains a separate issue.
boundaries: Collection of the wrong parcel does not fulfil the reporting customer’s own order.
notes: customer holds someone else's sealed parcel; carrier collects; do not ask to open or forward; own order traced separately

title: Wrong item inside a correctly addressed parcel
next_action_text: Ask the merchant to authorise the documented item exchange.
outcome: The merchant confirms exchange approval and a collection booking; the exchange is not yet complete.
boundaries: Exchange approval and collection booking are not completed return or replacement delivery.
notes: SKU mismatch verified by the merchant; exchange authority sits with the returns team

title: Refrigerated food arrives outside the merchant's documented temperature conditions
next_action_text: Escalate the recorded temperature evidence to the merchant's food-safety team, without advising consumption.
outcome: The authorised team confirms its disposition and remedy for this order; no general safety judgment is made by the agent.
boundaries: The range is an attributed fictional merchant condition, not a universal legal rule. The agent makes no independent food-safety assessment.
notes: chilled food at 9.2 C against a 0-5 C merchant condition; only food-safety staff decide disposition; no consumption advice

title: A high-value shipment lacks an accessible proof-of-delivery record
context_author: Secure shipment support, Plover Arc Logistics
gold_recipient: Secure shipment support, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Request the permitted handover record from carrier support.
outcome: The carrier supplies the matching record and the verified recipient confirms the recorded handover; no document is treated as universal proof by itself.
boundaries: Record and recipient acknowledgement support this handover only; neither proves contents quality or all future disputes.
notes: high-value item; redacted POD through the verified thread; no driver or other-recipient details

title: Return approved but the customer has no return label
next_action_text: Ask the merchant's returns team to issue the missing label.
outcome: The customer confirms receipt of a usable label matching the approved return.
boundaries: Label issuance is not return collection, warehouse receipt or refund.
notes: approved return with an empty label field; the label team issues against RT-031

title: Customer cannot print a return label
next_action_text: Request an available printer-free return option from the merchant.
outcome: The customer receives a valid QR code and confirmed supported drop-off location.
boundaries: Token receipt is not drop-off or refund. QR payload is inert, not a live return authorisation.
notes: printer-free QR token at a named counter; no payment or credential URL

title: Courier misses a booked return collection
next_action_text: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.
outcome: The courier confirms collection and issues the matching receipt.
boundaries: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.
notes: missed collection; rebook within the customer window; proof is the collection receipt not a booking status

title: Returned parcel has reached the carrier depot but not the merchant warehouse
gold_recipient: Returns trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask the carrier's returns team to trace the parcel to the merchant.
outcome: The merchant warehouse confirms physical receipt; refund approval remains separate.
boundaries: Merchant physical receipt does not establish accepted condition, refund approval or payment.
notes: trace the return to the merchant; proof is physical warehouse acceptance not a departure scan

title: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started
next_action_text: Send the receipt reference to the merchant's authorised refunds team.
outcome: The team confirms the review is registered and provides its next update date; payment is not claimed.
boundaries: Registered review is not an approved refund or money received.
notes: warehouse receipt exists but no refund review; refunds team registers the review; receipt is not approval

title: Business sender needs collection of several labelled cartons
requester: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
context_author: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
next_action_text: Ask the collection planner to confirm capacity for the stated carton count, sizes and weights.
outcome: The planner confirms the collection booking and shipment manifest; pickup remains pending.
boundaries: Capacity reservation and accepted manifest do not prove collection.
notes: four cartons as one manifest; planner confirms capacity; pickup pending

title: Customer needs an eligible heavy item collected from inside the home
next_action_text: Request the merchant's available specialist collection service with confirmed access details.
outcome: The authorised team confirms the appropriate crew and collection slot; no unsupported handling instructions are given.
boundaries: Do not instruct the customer to lift, dismantle or drag the item; booking does not prove safe collection.
notes: 54 kg cabinet; specialist two-person crew; never ask the customer to move it

title: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order
next_action_text: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details.
outcome: The merchant confirms a new shipment reference; receipt remains pending.
boundaries: New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.
notes: item back in stock; reshipment to the verified unchanged address needs merchant approval

title: Merchant shipped a replacement but the original parcel then also arrived
next_action_text: Request the merchant's instructions for an authorised duplicate return.
outcome: The merchant confirms collection of the agreed duplicate and reconciles the order quantities.
boundaries: Carrier recovery reconciles the duplicate quantity; do not assert warehouse inspection or product quality.
notes: original and replacement both delivered; the merchant chooses the unit and authorises the duplicate return

title: Cancelled order is packed but has not left the merchant warehouse
next_action_text: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority.
outcome: The warehouse confirms the package was removed from outbound dispatch; refund processing remains separate.
boundaries: Dispatch stop is not a refund approval, payment or completed customer communication.
notes: stop dispatch before the next outbound sweep using the recorded cancellation authority; refund is separate

title: Pallet delivery lacks a receiving-dock appointment
next_action_text: Contact the consignee's receiving coordinator to book an available dock slot.
outcome: The consignee and carrier confirm the same appointment reference and time.
boundaries: An appointment reference establishes coordinated booking, not pallet receipt.
notes: consignee dock appointment required; carrier and consignee must share the reference and time

title: Warehouse has no forklift for a booked pallet delivery
requester: Voren Tesk, Fenwick Spur receiving coordinator
context_author: Freight account services, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask the carrier planner to arrange the appropriate unloading service under the agreed booking terms.
outcome: The planner confirms a suitable vehicle and agreed service cost; unloading remains pending.
boundaries: No manual-lifting advice. Planner allocation and authorised cost are not payment or completed unloading.
notes: no forklift at the consignee; the coordinator holds GBP 30 authority for an unloading service; the desk must not suggest manual unloading

title: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight
requester: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
context_author: Freight booking desk, Plover Arc Logistics
gold_recipient: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
next_action_text: Ask the shipper for measured dimensions and weight before carrier allocation.
outcome: The carrier accepts the updated booking data and confirms the collection allocation.
boundaries: Customer measurements are not an independent carrier weighing; allocation is not collection.
notes: blank dimensions and weight; the shipper supplies measured values; customer measurements are not a carrier weighing

title: One pallet is absent from a business consignment
requester: Eron Leth, Kestrel Loom receiving coordinator
context_author: Eron Leth, Kestrel Loom receiving coordinator
gold_recipient: Freight trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
next_action_text: Ask the carrier to trace the missing pallet by its individual identifier.
outcome: The consignee confirms receipt of the missing pallet and signs the reconciled count.
boundaries: Reconciled pallet receipt is not a contents inspection or contractual payment acceptance.
notes: three of four pallets; trace P4 by its own ID; close only on the revised signed count

title: Import shipment is waiting for the shipper's commercial invoice
requester: Ossmere Trade Desk, appointed customs broker
context_author: Ossmere Trade Desk, appointed customs broker
gold_recipient: Fera Noll, Mavelle Export Studio shipping lead
next_action_text: Request the missing invoice fields specified by the appointed customs broker from the shipper.
outcome: The broker confirms receipt of a complete document package; customs clearance is not claimed.
boundaries: Fictional broker requirements are not universal customs law; document completeness is not clearance.
notes: broker lists the missing invoice fields; the shipper must supply them; the desk must not fill values or origin

title: Import broker needs the consignee to appoint it before processing
gold_recipient: Mara Vesk, Celand Arc authorised director
next_action_text: Ask the consignee's authorised representative to complete the broker's stated appointment process.
outcome: The broker confirms acceptance of the appointment; shipment clearance remains pending.
boundaries: Director title alone is not authority; the independent account register and verified acceptance establish this limited appointment.
notes: broker mandate must be accepted by the registered signatory in the verified portal; a title alone is not authority

title: Customer asks for an explanation of a carrier-issued import charge
next_action_text: Request an itemised explanation from the carrier's billing team through a verified channel.
outcome: Billing supplies the charge breakdown and the customer receives it; no payment or waiver is implied.
boundaries: Do not invent statutory rates or send payment links. Explanation is not settlement or release of goods.
notes: customer wants the GBP 32 charge itemised before deciding; the desk relays the request and cannot waive or collect

title: International shipment is cleared but awaiting last-mile handover
next_action_text: Ask the carrier's transfer team for the local carrier reference and handover status.
outcome: The local carrier confirms physical receipt and a usable tracking reference; delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Clearance and local receipt do not establish final delivery or a promised arrival time.
notes: clearance is not delivery; confirm the physical last-mile handover and the local reference

title: Duplicate delivery service charge appears on a business invoice
requester: Vera Senn, Mossline Press finance coordinator
context_author: Vera Senn, Mossline Press finance coordinator
next_action_text: Ask the carrier's authorised billing team to review the two matching charge lines.
outcome: Billing issues a credit note for the confirmed duplicate and the revised invoice reconciles.
boundaries: A credit note is an accounting adjustment, not cash received. GBP 36.00 minus GBP 18.00 equals GBP 18.00 due.
notes: two identical invoice lines; billing confirms the duplicate and issues a credit; a credit is not cash

title: Customer requests reimbursement of a guaranteed-delivery surcharge after confirmed delay
next_action_text: Submit a service-guarantee request to the carrier with the confirmed timestamps and applicable fictional booking terms.
outcome: The authorised billing team confirms the approved surcharge credit and reference; other losses are outside this case.
boundaries: The delay is 40 minutes; do not multiply the surcharge or promise compensation for unrelated losses. Posted credit is not money received.
notes: customer asks only for the GBP 7.50 surcharge under the guarantee terms after a 40-minute delay; billing decides
